observations: Three photos show a desktop PC with a transparent side panel, illuminated with RGB lighting in orange, blue, and red.
The case has multiple fans with ring lighting, a vertical white radiator or water cooling block, and visible internal components.
A remote control is held in front of the case in photo 0, suggesting RGB lighting is controllable.
The case is wrapped in plastic film, indicating it may be new or recently assembled.
A yellow warning sticker with Chinese characters is visible on the top left of the case in all photos.
No brand or model name is visible on the case, motherboard, or any component in the photos.
The seller claims it is a 'gaming desktop' with an 'intel(r)' processor, but no such text is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The seller states it is a 'gaming desktop', but no brand or model is visible in the photos. The visual features (RGB, multiple fans, water cooling) support the description as a gaming desktop.
The seller claims an Intel processor, but no CPU, motherboard, or label showing the brand or model is visible in any photo. The processor is not visible inside the case.

risks.risk: The case may be a generic or unbranded model, not a known brand like ASUS, MSI, or others.

A close-up of the case's front or side panel to check for any brand name.
